scope: Manual adjudication of the 30-item random sample in results/stale_audit_sample_mistral.json, drawn from Mistral-Large-2 items the lexical rule in pipeline/stale_taxonomy.py labelled `grounded_outdated`.
why_a_separate_sample: The first audit covered only Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen2.5-3B, because Mistral-Large-2's stale run had not finished. Applying that sample's precision to Mistral would have been an extrapolation across a 4x-40x capability gap, and Mistral's automatic profile already differed sharply (37.2% grounded_outdated and 30.7% abstained, against 53.6%/15.7% at 32B). We therefore drew and adjudicated a separate sample rather than reuse the Qwen precision.

provenance.note: Same rubric and same unblinded single-annotator limitation as the Qwen audit; the adjudicator saw the automatic label, which biases toward confirming it.
